propositions: Free-text extraction from model replies remains heuristic and allows schema-valid decoy objects to win over intended payloads when no explicit output channel is defined.
The current parser cannot reliably distinguish the intended JSON object from fence-wrapped content and trailing schema-valid decoys in model replies.

An explicit sentinel-marker channel (<<<REBAR_OUTPUT>>> / <<<END>>>) with line-anchored, non-nested pairing and last-block-wins semantics prevents decoy selection and ensures fail-closed behavior when marker-wrapped content is invalid.
The bounded-retry prompt in structured_run.py instructs bare JSON without markers, contradicting the first-attempt directive and breaking the fail-closed retry channel that layer 4 depends on.
The marker directive must be single-sourced as a module constant to ensure exact consistency between the instruction given to the model, the extraction logic, and the measurement harness.
